## Checklist

- [ ] Files are in `problems/<problem-slug>/` (reports in `reports/`, steps in `map/nodes/`, organisations in `network/`).
- [ ] Every `id` matches its file name, and new steps are listed in a parent's `children`.
- [ ] Every figure and role has a source, or is marked as an estimate.
- [ ] Review status stays `draft` or `generated` (only reviewers set `reviewed`).
- [ ] Gaps are listed rather than guessed.
